|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf) (PDF created 2 August 2024), cut unchanged from page 4. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Playtest''' ([[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel (Playtest)]]): the pre-release card image (20 December 2023, the Virtual Set 23 preview)<ref name="ht-73ae2bd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/hires/jynersoheroicrebel.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository; later publisher image at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif res.starwarsccg.org] in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80 73ae2bd] “Set 23 Preview”, 20 December 2023, the Virtual Set 23 preview.</ref> prints: “While Stardust on your spy, Jyn adds one battle destiny. While Stardust on Jyn and present at a battleground, Force drain +1 here and non-trooper Rebel spies here may not be ‘choked.’ If just lost, opponent loses 1 Force.”<ref name="cj-8d3b539">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/8d3b539101d70f08c5f6e9d812f8b8d4e5a61524 swccg-card-json commit 8d3b539] “Set 23 Preview and December 2023 Errata” (21 December 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''Original''' ([[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024, with the Virtual Set 23 release images)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024, with the Virtual Set 23 release images.</ref> prints: “While Stardust on your spy, Jyn adds one battle destiny. While Stardust on Jyn and present at a battleground, Force drain +1 here and non-trooper Rebel spies here may not be ‘choked.’ If just lost, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The third stat box, empty on the first image (the December 2023 preview), now prints “FORCE-ATTUNED”. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.

Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 2 August 2024: “While Stardust on your spy, Jyn adds one battle destiny. While Stardust on Jyn and present at a battleground, Force drain +1 here and non-trooper Rebel spies here may not be 'choked.' If just lost, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]] (repository revision 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel”; the printed face matches the image in visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
